overview.location: Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood and Dania Beach, Broward County, Florida. Main address: 1850 Eller Drive, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316. 1.8 miles from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL).
overview.passengerVolume: 4,773,873 cruise passengers in fiscal year 2025 (preliminary; FY ends Sept 30), a record and up about 16% year over year
overview.distinction: World's third-busiest cruise homeport in FY2025, behind Port Canaveral and PortMiami. Disney Cruise Line's second year-round homeport. Royal Caribbean's Icon-class Legend of the Seas begins sailing from the port in November 2026.
cruiseLines: Balearia Caribbean (daily ferry to the Bahamas)
overview.cruiseLinesNote: As listed by the port on 2026-10-13. Carnival, MSC and Norwegian are NOT on the port's current cruise-lines page. Do not write content saying they sail from Port Everglades without re-verifying.

terminalAssignmentNote: Terminal assignments change by sailing. The port shows ship names and terminal assignments on digital signs at the entrances and publishes Today's Ship Schedule (https://pevvesseltraffic.broward.org/webx/). Always tell readers to confirm the terminal on their cruise documents. Only T2 (Princess), T4 (Disney) and T25 (Celebrity) are confirmed by the port's own pages.
roads: I-595 East to the Port Everglades exit (Eller Drive) - main entrance, Checkpoint 1, open 24/7
I-95: Exit 26 southbound or Exit 24 northbound to I-595 East
Florida's Turnpike: Exit 54 to I-595 East
State Road 84 at Spangler Blvd - Checkpoint 2, 6 AM-6 PM
SE 17th Street (17th Street Causeway) at Eisenhower Blvd - Checkpoint 3, 6 AM-6 PM
transit: Broward County Transit (BCT) buses stop at the Northport section on SE 17th St. Schedules: 954-357-8400
No rail service into the port

fromFLL.allowTime: Port advises allowing 45 minutes to 1 hour for the airport-to-port transfer, and at least 45 minutes between flight arrival and cruise check-in
fromFLL.taxi: Average taxi fare FLL to Port Everglades $18-$21, subject to change (port Getting Here page)
fromFLL.rideshare: Uber/Lyft roughly $15-$25 per car one way (third-party estimates; surge pricing on embarkation mornings). Enter your exact terminal number as the destination.

groundTransportation.fromMIA: 27 miles; port advises 2-3 hours for the airport-to-port transfer
groundTransportation.fromPBI: 50 miles; port advises 3-4 hours for the airport-to-port transfer
groundTransportation.betweenTerminalsTaxi: Flat $8 taxi rate between terminals; no negotiated rideshare rate
groundTransportation.taxiRideshareZones: Taxis, rideshare, coaches and hotel vehicles use designated areas outside each terminal
groundTransportation.cellPhoneLots: Free cell phone waiting lots for people picking up debarking guests: Port Administration Building (1850 Eller Drive, just past the security checkpoint) and a lot north of Cruise Terminal 18
groundTransportation.cruiseLineTransfers: Many cruise packages include airport/hotel transfers - check with the cruise line
groundTransportation.hotelTransfers: Within Triply's POE inventory, only Courtyard Fort Lauderdale Airport and Marriott Fort Lauderdale Airport sell a port transfer ($20 per person one way). Park By The Ports Cruise Parking includes the port shuttle for up to 4 passengers.

parkingRates: Port garages and lots (Heron Garage, Palm Garage, Lots A-D): $25 daily maximum, hourly from $5. Oversized vehicles up to 24 ft: $18 first 5 hours, $35 per 24 hours. No reservations or pre-payment - pay on site. Off-site: Park By The Ports Cruise Parking from ~$13.45/day lot rate with included port shuttle (up to 4 passengers). Source: porteverglades.net/cruise/parking (verified 2026-10-13).

onAirportParking._note: Key name kept for engine compatibility. These are the PORT'S OWN garages and surface lots, not airport parking. The port's current pages name them Heron and Palm garages; older guides call them Northport and Midport - do not state a rename as fact.

heronGarage.name: Heron Parking Garage (Northport)
heronGarage.serves: Cruise Terminals 2 and 4. Elevated air-conditioned passenger bridge from the 5th floor to Terminal 2; moving walkways.
heronGarage.hourlyRates: $5 up to 1 hr; $10 1-5 hrs; $13 5-6 hrs; $14 6-7 hrs; $18 7-9 hrs; $20 9-11 hrs; $23 11-12 hrs; $25 over 12 hrs (daily max)

palmGarage.name: Palm Parking Garage (Midport)
palmGarage.serves: Cruise Terminals 19, 21, 25, 26 and 29. Located next to Terminal 21; free shuttle to Terminal 29.

oversizedVehicles.rule: Vehicles exceeding standard space width/height; limited spaces for vehicles up to 24 feet, including those too tall for garage upper floors
oversizedVehicles.rates: $18 first 5 hours or portion; $35 up to 24 hours

paymentRules.reservations: The port does not accept reservations or pre-payment for parking
paymentRules.methods: Cash, credit or debit on site; contactless payment machines on the first floor of the garages
paymentRules.tip: Bring the parking ticket on the cruise and pay at the machine before returning to the car to speed exit
paymentRules.clock: Daily rates begin when you pull the ticket at the garage or lot entry
paymentRules.afterDebarkation: Vehicles must leave after debarkation on the return morning; facilities are not staffed 24/7 or on non-cruise days

disabledParking.description: All public garages and surface lots include disabled parking 'with unimpeded access to crosswalks and elevators'. Terminals are described as fully accessible. No separate disabled rate is published.

securityAndScreening.secureFacility: Port Everglades is a secure seaport. Every road entrance has a security checkpoint, and cruise guests may enter only the cruise area.
securityAndScreening.idRequirement: Guests and visitors 18 and older must show a government-issued photo ID (driver's license or passport) plus cruise documents at the checkpoint
checkpoints: Checkpoint 2 - State Road 84 / Spangler Blvd: 6 AM-6 PM
Checkpoint 3 - SE 17th St. / Eisenhower Blvd: 6 AM-6 PM
securityAndScreening.vehicleScreening: Vehicles may be screened at any checkpoint
securityAndScreening.parkingPlacard: Drivers receive a placard to display on the rear-view mirror or driver-side dashboard
securityAndScreening.noUnattendedVehicles: Do not leave vehicles unattended in No Parking zones, fire lanes or drop-off areas
securityAndScreening.weapons: Florida Statute 311.12(7) makes it unlawful to possess a weapon on a seaport or keep one in your vehicle there
securityAndScreening.prohibitedItems: Firearms, ammunition, stun guns/tasers, explosives, fireworks, flares, fuels, chlorine, liquid bleach, tear gas and similar
securityAndScreening.tsaPreCheck: Not applicable - cruise screening is run by the cruise lines at the terminal

lounges.notApplicable: Seaport - no airport lounges. Terminals have VIP areas for cruise-line priority guests.

wifi.coverage: Port says each air-conditioned cruise terminal offers free Wi-Fi

evCharging.note: verify - not stated on the port's parking page

luggageStorage.onSite: The port cannot store luggage for security reasons
luggageStorage.porters: Cruise-line porters at the front of each terminal take tagged bags to your cabin; if driving, drop bags at the terminal before parking. Tipping optional.

petFacilities.note: verify - not stated on port pages

peakTravelTimes.cruiseSeason: Peak Caribbean cruise season is roughly November through April; the port's fiscal-year cruise season begins in October
peakTravelTimes.fy2026: 40 cruise ships from 9 lines plus a daily ferry (port forecast for FY2026)
peakTravelTimes.embarkationDay: Arrive at the check-in time your cruise line assigns - the port advises not arriving earlier. Debarkation typically 7-9 AM, so garages, rideshare and the airport roads are busiest mid-morning.
peakTravelTimes.airportTiming: Airlines at FLL may only check bags up to 2 hours before the flight - avoid booking flights earlier than about 11 AM-noon on debarkation day
peakTravelTimes.multiShipDays: verify - check Today's Ship Schedule (https://pevvesseltraffic.broward.org/webx/) for days with several ships in port
peakTravelTimes.holidayPeaks: Thanksgiving, Christmas-New Year, Presidents' Day and spring break weeks

weatherPatterns.climate: Tropical monsoon climate: warm year-round, wet season May-October
weatherPatterns.hurricaneSeason: June 1 - November 30 (peak August-October). Storms can shift embarkation dates or close the port; check your cruise line and the port's alerts.
weatherPatterns.tips: Afternoon thunderstorms are common in summer - covered port garages or a covered hotel garage keep cars cooler; most off-site cruise lots are open-air

parkSleepFly.description: 'Stay, park and cruise' hotel packages. In Triply's POE inventory, only two FLL-airport hotels offer a port transfer, and it is PAID: Courtyard Fort Lauderdale Airport and Marriott Fort Lauderdale Airport - parking includes an airport shuttle only; the cruise port shuttle is $20 per person one way.
